# EasyList

Source: https://easylist.to/easylist/easylist.txt

Snapshot retrieved 25 October 2026. Original header, version and commit remain in
app/src/main/assets/hifi/easylist.txt. Original licence page is in LICENCE.html.
This project uses EasyList under GPL version 3 or later, compatible with the app.

HiFi Player implements a conservative subset: unconditional domain anchors,
third-party domain anchors and cosmetic selectors specifically for RYM. Other
Adblock Plus syntax and exception-dependent rules are not interpreted. This is
not a complete EasyList-compatible engine and does not guarantee blocking every
advertisement. The browser menu allows disabling the filter and reloading.
